purpose: Inventory the bead-shaped invariants the daemon enforces today, with file:line evidence

invariants.name: ci_green
invariants.vacuous_risk: EMPTY checks list -> 'unknown' (NOT red). Pending checks mask failures. The 30s run_tool timeout can yield empty 'unknown' on slow gh.

invariants.name: no_conflicts
invariants.vacuous_risk: GitHub returns 'UNKNOWN' while computing -> mapped to 'unknown' (NOT red). Old branches with stale mergeable can stay UNKNOWN.

invariants.name: coderabbit
invariants.vacuous_risk: ALL-COMMENTED reviews filtered out (line 138) -> no reviews left -> 'unknown' (NOT red). PR without any CodeRabbit review (e.g. small diffs, private fork) vacuously passes.

invariants.name: bugbot

verdict_shape.green: 0 comments matching cursor|bugbot AND body containing 'error' or 'fail'

invariants.vacuous_risk: Body substring 'fail' matches ANY word containing those letters: 'failure-rate', 'failing test', 'feasibility', 'failover'. FALSE POSITIVE: substantive BugBot advice containing 'no failures detected' trips red. FALSE NEGATIVE: BugBot posts no comment at all -> 0 -> green (vacuous).

invariants.name: comments_resolved
invariants.input: gh api graphql query with reviewThreads(first:100)
invariants.vacuous_risk: first:100 caps the page; PRs with 100+ unresolved threads (long-lived PRs) silently get 'green' on the first page. Missing pullRequest in response (deleted PR / no auth) -> unresolved_thread_count = 0 -> green (vacuous).
invariants.current_passes: Stable; pagination bug a known risk

invariants.name: evidence_review

verdict_shape.green: (/er Pass AND evidence_gist Verified) OR (non_test_changed_loc <= 100 AND no marker needed)
verdict_shape.red: EvidenceGistStatus::Failed (r5 fail-closed) OR /er Fail/Inconclusive/Partial (PRODUCTION) OR above LOC floor with NotProvided

invariants.vacuous_risk: non_test_changed_loc <= 100 unconditionally green (no evidence required). A 99-LOC production bug PR bypasses all evidence requirements.
invariants.current_passes: Tightened r5; previously bypassed via substring floor (bead jleechan-yoqy)

invariants.name: skeptic

verdict_shape.red: Fail OR (Pass/Warn + review_degraded=true: cross-model guarantee violated, issue #385)

invariants.vacuous_risk: Warn is non-blocking (line 909) — skeptic can say 'I see problems' and gate stays green. If a vendor ran with degraded review (single-model), Pass->Red (good); if no vendor ran at all (total outage), review_degraded=true AND skeptic=None -> Unknown. BUT if reviewer pool has 1+ entries with overlapping model families, single-family detection may miss.

invariants.name: vacuous_red_green

verdict_shape.green: NotProvided (test-repo fast lane) OR Genuine OR BaselineFailed
verdict_shape.red: Vacuous (tests pass on reverted production tree)
verdict_shape.unknown: GreenFailed OR NoChangedTests OR ManifestMissing OR CargoNotFound OR PytestNotFound

invariants.vacuous_risk: BaselineFailed -> GREEN (line 965): infra can't materialize base worktree (no GH_TOKEN, gh pr view failed) -> vacuous detector returns BaselineFailed -> gate passes green. A PR where the detector CAN'T actually run still passes the gate. test-repo PRs (NotProvided) get unconditional green.

invariants.name: vendor_waiver
invariants.vacuous_risk: If Skeptic returns Pass from a single-family review but review_degraded=false (e.g. fall-through bug), compensating coverage is asserted green -> vendor waiver silently substitutes. The three signals must all three be green per the contract, but bug in compute_review_degraded could leak through.

invariants.name: pipeline_gate_strict
invariants.vacuous_risk: All 6 gates set gate_strict=true but the ONLY enforced consequence is 'route to fix'. After 3 fix iterations (max_visits=3) the run terminates regardless of remaining defects. gate_cs at line 102 has no !success edge -> vacuous: gate_cs fail path goes UNROUTED.
invariants.current_passes: Pipeline shape; not auto-detected by graph_audit

summary: 10 invariants currently enforced. Vacuous-risk items cluster in: substring-based body matching (I04), pagination caps (I05), 'unknown != red' uncertainty gaps (I01, I02, I03, I07), and infra-failure -> green paths (I08 BaselineFailed, I09 waiver chain). Tessl would re-shape each: replace substring matching with structured fields (P1), add a per-gate analytics dashboard (P2), and tier the gate-block vs gate-warn vs gate-noop (P3).
